name: Dagger: Ginkan no Chikai
source:
3rd in the DAGGER series... 
Several days after the events of Spectral Warriors... 

Tisto is nominated to become royalty to Royce, an act which requires a contract with a servant. 

-I ask you to be with me, sleep and eat with me, and walk my path, together-
In receiving the words Yui's own dream comes true. 

Tisto becomes royalty, 
and the story enters a new phase.

[From [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE127025.html]DLsite English[/url]]
